description: Start the ce-net sign-in with no browser: registers this agent as an OAuth client and returns a user_code and the link your person opens. Then poll account_device_poll with client_id and device_code. The door keeps no client and no token; hold them yourself. A person still presses Allow - that is their consent, not a bug.
